notes:
Excel to PDF is new: a workbook printed the way it looks, keeping its number formats, fonts, colours, merged cells and column widths. Hidden sheets stay hidden, and charts are not drawn.

The tools are arranged in pairs now, each converter directly under the one it reverses.

Help has become a full manual - every tool, every option, and what each one will not do.

This notice is new too. It only appears because you asked to be told about updates; that setting is in the About panel.

HTML to PDF has been removed.
